## Transition Plan — 70 y/o, Hypertensive Heart Failure | Discharged to SNF (Fri 10/23/26)

**Why this patient is at risk**
High-tier readmission risk (score 0.30) driven by no 7-day follow-up booked, high comorbidity burden, and prior admissions in the last 12 months; follow-up status remains patient-to-call with no appointment scheduled.

---

**Within 48 hours**
- Pharmacist med-reconciliation call to SNF to confirm medication accuracy
- Confirm SNF received complete discharge summary
- Attempt outreach to book 7-day follow-up (HF Bridge Clinic or PCP)

**Within 7 days**
- Secure and confirm 7-day follow-up appointment (HF Bridge Clinic / PCP)
- Care-transitions nurse check-in call to SNF regarding clinical status
- Verify daily weights and fluid/symptom monitoring in place at SNF

**Social needs**
- No transport barrier identified; patient does not live alone
- Confirm SNF placement is stable and meeting care needs

**Teach-back topics**
- Daily weight monitoring and when to alert care team
- Signs/symptoms of worsening heart failure
- Medication purpose and adherence

---
